Services.title: Our Services
Services.subtitle: We provide professional mechanical installation solutions from design to implementation for every stage of your projects.

project.title: Mechanical Design
project.description: At TACH MECHANICAL, we provide professional mechanical design solutions based on engineering principles, international standards and modern design approaches. We perform requirement analysis, site evaluations, technical assessments and detailed engineering calculations to create the most suitable system designs for each project. We develop reliable, energy-efficient and long-lasting solutions for plumbing systems, HVAC, fire protection, ventilation, industrial mechanical installations and specialized systems.

exploration.title: Quantity Survey
exploration.description: At TACH MECHANICAL, we provide comprehensive pre-construction surveying services including detailed site inspections, technical evaluations, quantity take-offs and cost analysis. Our experienced team accurately identifies project requirements and develops efficient solutions to optimize investment budgets. Through professional survey studies prepared specifically for each project, we create a strong foundation for accurate planning, timely execution and high-quality mechanical installations.

plumbing.title: Plumbing Systems
plumbing.description:
At TACH MEKANİK, we provide reliable, efficient, and sustainable engineering solutions for plumbing systems, which are among the fundamental requirements of residential, commercial, and industrial facilities. We design and implement clean water, wastewater, rainwater, and hot water systems with accurate engineering calculations, high-quality material selection, and professional installation processes.

We manage all stages of plumbing projects, from design and engineering to installation and commissioning, for residential buildings, commercial facilities, hotels, hospitals, industrial plants, and special projects. By prioritizing water efficiency, hygiene standards, energy savings, and operational convenience, we develop modern solutions tailored to the needs of each project.

We provide professional services for clean water distribution systems, wastewater and drainage systems, rainwater collection systems, booster systems, and domestic hot water solutions in accordance with national and international application standards.

With a focus on quality, durability, and long-term performance, we deliver reliable and sustainable plumbing solutions that meet the highest expectations of our clients.

fire.title: Fire Protection Systems
fire.description:
At TACH MECHANIK, we design, engineer, and implement modern fire protection systems to ensure the safety of people, assets, and facilities. Based on internationally recognized NFPA, EN, and ISO standards, we provide reliable engineering solutions for industrial facilities, commercial buildings, hospitals, hotels, and special projects.

We professionally manage all stages of fire protection projects, including sprinkler systems, fire hose cabinets, hydrant systems, fire pumps, fire alarm systems, and special suppression solutions, from design and equipment selection to installation, testing, and commissioning.

By developing solutions in accordance with NFPA 13, NFPA 20, NFPA 72, NFPA 2001 standards, as well as EN 12845, EN 15004, and CEN/TS 54-14 criteria, we create high-performance, sustainable, and long-lasting fire safety systems.

In every project, we prioritize reliability, rapid response, quality, and operational continuity, providing our customers with effective fire protection solutions that meet international standards.

ventilation.title: Ventilation Systems
ventilation.description: As TACH Mekanik, we design and implement high-performance ventilation systems for industrial facilities, hospitals, hotels, shopping malls, offices, and residential projects. With our expert engineering approach, we provide solutions that maximize fresh air circulation, indoor air quality, and energy efficiency. We create safe and comfortable environments with fresh air supply systems, exhaust systems, smoke extraction solutions, car park ventilation, heat recovery ventilation systems, and customized mechanical solutions for special projects. We professionally manage all processes including survey, engineering design, installation, testing, and commissioning to deliver long-lasting and efficient ventilation systems.

hvac.title: Heating & Cooling Systems
hvac.description: As TACH Mekanik, we provide high-efficiency heating and cooling system solutions for residential projects, villas, hotels, hospitals, shopping malls, offices, and industrial facilities. We design and implement comfortable, energy-efficient climate control solutions including central heating systems, air conditioning systems, chillers, fan coil applications, boilers, heat pumps, and modern HVAC technologies according to project requirements. Our experienced engineering team professionally manages all processes including site surveys, capacity calculations, system design, equipment selection, installation, commissioning, and technical support. With the use of quality equipment, accurate engineering calculations, and precise installation methods, we create reliable, long-lasting mechanical systems that reduce operating costs and provide maximum comfort.

vrf.title: VRF Systems
vrf.description: As TACH Mekanik, we design and implement modern VRF air conditioning systems for hotels, hospitals, offices, shopping centers, villas, commercial buildings and other projects. Our VRF solutions provide individual temperature control, high energy efficiency and maximum comfort through variable refrigerant flow technology. Each system is designed according to the characteristics of the building, its intended use and the requirements of the client. Our experienced engineering team professionally manages site surveys, capacity calculations, system design, equipment selection, installation, testing and commissioning. With quality equipment and precise engineering applications, we provide reliable, quiet, energy-efficient and long-lasting VRF systems.

medical.title: Medical Gas Systems
medical.description: As TACH Mekanik, we design and implement medical gas systems in accordance with international standards for hospitals, healthcare centers, clinics, and medical facilities. We provide safe, continuous, and high-performance solutions for medical gas infrastructures including oxygen, medical air, vacuum, nitrous oxide, carbon dioxide, and other medical gases. Our expert engineering team manages the entire process including project planning, system design, pipeline installation, control panels, alarm systems, terminal units, testing, and commissioning. By prioritizing patient safety, system reliability, and hygiene standards, we deliver professional medical gas solutions with high-quality materials and precise installation methods. TACH Mekanik provides reliable mechanical infrastructure solutions for healthcare facilities from design to completion.

pool.title: Swimming Pool Systems
pool.description: As TACH Mekanik, we design and implement modern pool mechanical systems for villas, hotels, residential complexes, sports facilities, and private projects. We provide professional solutions including pool filtration systems, circulation pumps, balance tanks, automation systems, water treatment solutions, and auxiliary mechanical equipment. According to the purpose and architectural features of each project, we develop energy-efficient, hygienic, and long-lasting system solutions. Our expert team professionally manages all processes including site surveys, hydraulic calculations, equipment selection, installation, testing, and commissioning. With high-quality materials and precise engineering applications, we ensure that pool systems operate continuously with clean, safe, and comfortable water conditions.

landscape.title: Landscape Irrigation Systems
landscape.description: As TACH Mekanik, we design and implement modern landscape irrigation systems for residential projects, villas, hotels, residential complexes, parks, gardens, and commercial areas. We provide efficient automatic irrigation solutions including drip irrigation systems, sprinkler systems, pump groups, and smart control systems to ensure the effective and sustainable use of water resources. By considering the characteristics of the landscape, soil structure, and plant requirements, we develop energy-efficient and long-lasting irrigation solutions. Our professional team manages all processes including site surveys, system design, equipment selection, installation, testing, and commissioning. With high-quality materials and precise engineering solutions, we ensure the healthy maintenance of green areas and provide reliable, environmentally friendly, and cost-effective landscape irrigation systems.

treatment.title: Water Treatment Systems
treatment.description: As TACH Mekanik, we provide professional water treatment and wastewater treatment solutions for residential projects, villas, hotels, industrial facilities, and commercial buildings. We design and implement drinking water treatment systems, process water solutions, wastewater treatment systems, greywater recycling systems, and advanced filtration solutions according to project requirements. Our experienced engineering team professionally manages all processes including water analysis, capacity calculations, system design, equipment selection, installation, testing, and commissioning. By using energy-efficient technologies, high-quality equipment, and modern engineering methods, we create sustainable, reliable, and long-lasting treatment systems that contribute to efficient water resource management. TACH Mekanik provides comprehensive water treatment solutions with a professional approach at every stage of the project.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure Systems
infrastructure.description: As TACH Mekanik, we provide reliable mechanical infrastructure solutions for residential projects, villas, hotels, residential complexes, commercial buildings, and large-scale construction projects. We design and implement clean water supply systems, wastewater systems, stormwater drainage infrastructure, building connection lines, and mechanical infrastructure applications according to project requirements. Our experienced engineering team professionally manages all processes including site surveys, hydraulic calculations, system design, material selection, installation, testing, and commissioning. With accurate engineering calculations, high-quality materials, and modern installation techniques, we create long-lasting, safe, and efficient infrastructure systems. TACH Mekanik is your reliable solution partner for mechanical infrastructure projects from the initial design stage to final completion.

About.title: About Us
About.heading: Reliable Mechanical Solutions Since 1987
About.text1: TACH Mechanical is an engineering company specialized in mechanical installation systems for industrial and commercial buildings, providing reliable and high-quality services.
About.text2: We offer turnkey solutions in fire protection, ventilation, plumbing, HVAC, VRF, medical gas and infrastructure systems through design, implementation and maintenance services.

hero.title: About Us
hero.subtitle: Since 1987, we have been combining trust, quality and engineering excellence in the mechanical installation industry.

intro.title: Building the Future with Experience
intro.text1: TACH Mechanical was founded on the knowledge, experience and engineering expertise gained in the mechanical installation sector since 1987. From the very beginning, we have adopted quality, reliability and customer satisfaction as our core principles, successfully completing projects ranging from residential buildings and industrial facilities to hotels, hospitals, educational institutions and commercial developments.
intro.text2: By closely following technological advancements, we develop modern mechanical installation solutions that comply with international standards while prioritizing energy efficiency. Every project is carried out with the same level of precision, combining aesthetics, safety, sustainability and long-lasting performance.
intro.text3: Today, with more than 39 years of industry experience, we are proud to be more than just a mechanical installation contractor. We are a trusted engineering partner that delivers value-driven, innovative and reliable solutions for every project.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To deliver reliable, high-quality and sustainable mechanical installation solutions while exceeding customer expectations and adding value to every project through professional engineering principles.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To become one of the leading engineering companies recognized for reliability, innovation and internationally compliant mechanical installation solutions focused on energy efficiency.

why.title: Why TACH Mechanical?
why.text: With nearly four decades of industry experience, a highly qualified engineering team, premium-quality materials and an on-time delivery approach, we provide durable and reliable mechanical installation solutions. Customer satisfaction, trust and engineering excellence remain the foundation of every project we undertake.

We provide solutions suitable for different types of buildings, from residential and commercial projects to industrial facilities and large-scale developments.
PlumbingPage.intro2: We handle the entire process from system design to implementation in accordance with engineering principles, creating safe and efficient installations through correct pipe sizing, appropriate material selection and adequate pressure and flow calculations.

PlumbingPage.safetyText2: TACH MECHANICAL selects appropriate materials and equipment with the goal of ensuring reliable operation for many years. By evaluating water losses, pressure problems and potential technical issues in advance, we provide sustainable solutions.
PlumbingPage.finalText: We create long-lasting plumbing systems through proper engineering, quality materials and professional implementation.

FirePage.title: FIRE PROTECTION SYSTEMS
FirePage.mainDescription1: At TACH MEKANİK, we design and install fire protection systems in accordance with national and international standards to ensure the safety of buildings against fire risks. We provide fire safety solutions suitable for different applications, from residential and commercial buildings to industrial facilities and large-scale structures.
FirePage.mainDescription2: In fire protection systems, we focus on accurate capacity calculations, proper equipment selection, and reliable installation principles. We ensure that the water required during a fire reaches the necessary points at the correct pressure and flow rates.
FirePage.scopeDescription: We develop fire extinguishing and fire protection systems according to the intended use, size, and fire risks of each building.

systems.12: Fire protection calculation and application projects

FirePage.safetyDescription1: The purpose of fire protection systems is to reduce intervention time during a fire and help bring the fire under control. Therefore, proper system design, appropriate equipment selection, and installation in accordance with technical standards are of great importance.
FirePage.safetyDescription2: TACH MEKANİK provides reliable, durable, and long-lasting fire protection solutions by evaluating fire safety requirements as a whole. We create accessible and sustainable solutions to ensure that system maintenance and operation processes can be carried out effectively.
FirePage.footerTitle: Effective Fire Solutions for Safe Buildings
FirePage.footerDescription: With proper engineering, quality equipment, and professional installation, we create reliable systems that contribute to the fire safety of buildings.

VentilationPage.title: VENTILATION SYSTEMS
VentilationPage.mainDescription1: At TACH MEKANİK, we design and install professional ventilation systems to create healthy and comfortable indoor conditions in buildings. We provide mechanical ventilation solutions tailored to different needs, from residential and commercial buildings to industrial facilities and large-scale projects.
VentilationPage.mainDescription2: We evaluate technical requirements such as fresh air demand, exhaust air, air change rates, and system capacity to create energy-efficient, reliable, and long-lasting ventilation systems.
VentilationPage.scopeDescription: We determine suitable ventilation systems by evaluating the purpose and technical requirements of each building individually, and we carry out design and installation processes in accordance with engineering principles.
VentilationPage.comfortDescription1: A properly designed ventilation system is essential for maintaining indoor air quality and ensuring user comfort. Providing sufficient fresh air and removing polluted air from the environment in a controlled manner are among the fundamental functions of the system.
VentilationPage.comfortDescription2: TACH MEKANİK creates balanced systems by evaluating air flow rates, duct dimensions, fan capacity, and air distribution together. We develop sustainable solutions by taking energy consumption and operating costs into consideration.
VentilationPage.footerDescription: With proper engineering, suitable equipment selection, and professional installation, we create efficient, reliable, and long-lasting ventilation systems.

HeatingCoolingPage.title: HEATING AND COOLING SYSTEMS
HeatingCoolingPage.mainDescription1: At TACH MEKANİK, we design and install comfortable, efficient, and reliable mechanical systems for the heating and cooling needs of buildings. We provide solutions suitable for different applications, from residential and commercial buildings to industrial facilities and large-scale projects.
HeatingCoolingPage.mainDescription2: We select the appropriate systems by evaluating the purpose, capacity, and technical requirements of each building. With accurate capacity calculations, suitable equipment, and proper piping design, we create energy-efficient and long-lasting systems.
HeatingCoolingPage.scopeDescription: We evaluate each project according to its specific requirements and develop engineering solutions suitable for the climate control and energy needs of buildings.

HeatingCoolingPage.comfortDescription1: Proper capacity selection, suitable equipment, and balanced system design are essential for energy consumption and user comfort in heating and cooling systems.
HeatingCoolingPage.comfortDescription2: TACH MEKANİK provides sustainable solutions by evaluating performance, energy efficiency, and operating costs together throughout all stages, from system design to installation.
HeatingCoolingPage.footerTitle: Climate Control Solutions for Every Building
HeatingCoolingPage.footerDescription: With proper engineering, quality equipment, and professional installation, we create comfortable, efficient, and long-lasting heating and cooling systems.

VRFPage.title: VRF SYSTEMS
VRFPage.mainDescription1: At TACH MEKANİK, we design and install high-efficiency VRF systems for the heating and cooling needs of different applications. We provide solutions suitable for residential buildings, offices, hotels, commercial buildings, and large-scale projects.
VRFPage.mainDescription2: We determine suitable combinations of outdoor and indoor units by evaluating the purpose, capacity, and architectural characteristics of each building. We consider energy efficiency and user comfort together.
VRFPage.scopeDescription: We manage all processes, from the design to the installation of VRF systems, in accordance with engineering principles and the technical requirements of each project.
VRFPage.efficiencyDescription1: VRF systems help optimize energy use by allowing different spaces to be controlled independently according to their individual needs. High comfort can be achieved through proper system design, equipment selection, and installation.
VRFPage.efficiencyDescription2: TACH MEKANİK creates balanced VRF solutions by evaluating system capacity and space requirements, prioritizing user comfort and energy efficiency.
VRFPage.footerTitle: Smart Climate Control for Modern Buildings
VRFPage.footerDescription: With proper engineering, suitable system selection, and professional installation, we create efficient, comfortable, and long-lasting VRF systems.

LandscapePage.title: LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS

LandscapePage.footerDescription: With proper engineering, suitable equipment, and professional installation, we create efficient, controlled, and long-lasting landscape irrigation systems.
